notes: Import Apple Notes, re-import iCloud Calendar, and edit or delete repeating iCloud events. Faster update checks and a redesigned update prompt. Improved calendar colors, instant deletes, local time zones, large iCloud calendars, Island and the AI model menu. Fixed events not syncing to iCloud, earlier sync failures, moving and renaming events, and note editing. Upgrade note: Re-importing iCloud removes events created in Void and linked to iCloud locally, along with their task links, colors and reminders. Their iCloud copies return as regular iCloud events; nothing in iCloud changes.
